title: Classic American Beef Burger
description: A simple recipe for a classic beef burger that is juicy and full of flavor. Serve on a toasted bun with your favorite toppings.
instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. Divide the ground beef into 4 equal portions and shape each into a ball.
3. Flatten each ball of beef into a patty.
4. Season the patties with salt and pepper.
5. Add the patties to the grill and cook for 4-5 minutes per side, or until they reach your desired level of doneness.
6. While the burgers are cooking, toast the buns on the grill.

7. Once the burgers are cooked, assemble the burgers by spreading mayonnaise or ketchup on the bottom bun, followed by a lettuce leaf, a tomato slice, a cheese slice, a beef patty, and finally the top bun.
8. Serve the burgers immediately and enjoy!
9. If desired, add sliced onions and pickles on top of the burger.
10. Serve with a side of fries or a salad.
11. Cook butter in a pan until it's golden brown and then brush it on the buns.
